name: Data root onboarding should walk you through steps
description:
Currently, data root onboarding takes you back to the original screen which makes a user believe an action was not done, and actions you select are within a modal.

- Remove modals, place on the screen
- Tabs at the top for sections
- Button to move forward, go back and skip onboarding.
- Indicate when a step has been completed (track onboarding progress in config)
